title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Location: Welwyn Garden City
Salary: £33,000
Working Pattern: Hybrid, 2 days in the office, 3 days working from home

Hours: 9am - 5pm, Monday to Friday

Contract: 12 months

We are looking for a creative and digitally minded Digital Marketing Executive to join a growing marketing team.

This is a varied role where you will help deliver digital campaigns across social media, websites, paid advertising and content, with plenty of opportunity to bring your own ideas and recommendations to the table.

The Role

You will support the wider marketing team in increasing brand awareness, engagement and customer acquisition across a range of digital channels.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Supporting digital acquisition campaigns across commercial and charity products
- Creating and recommending engaging digital content to increase awareness and drive conversions
- Supporting website improvements and helping to develop effective customer journeys
- Contributing to SEO and GEO activity, including keyword research and website optimisation
- Managing and updating Google Business Profile activity
- Supporting social media channels and online community management
- Assisting with paid search and PPC activity, making recommendations to improve performance
- Overseeing paid social campaigns designed to generate leads
- Supporting campaign reporting and analysing digital performance
- Assisting with digital budgets and testing different approaches to campaign delivery
- Supporting wider website transformation projects
- Attending occasional events across the UK when required

About You

We are looking for someone with previous experience in a digital marketing role who is confident working across multiple campaigns and channels.

You will ideally have:
- Experience working within digital marketing
- Experience delivering engagement campaigns through digital content and social media
- Good knowledge of social media platforms including Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube
- Experience with social media management and analytics tools such as Hootsuite
- Strong copywriting skills and a confident approach to creating engaging content
- An understanding of SEO, PPC and digital acquisition
- The ability to manage multiple projects and work to deadlines
- An understanding of how AI can be used to improve audience reach and engagement
- Excellent organisation and communication skills
- A creative eye for content, design and layout
- Strong IT skills, particularly Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook

What We Are Looking For

You will be proactive, organised and comfortable taking ownership of your work. You will enjoy working collaboratively but also be confident managing your own projects and priorities.

The ideal candidate will be creative and solutions focused, with a genuine interest in digital marketing and a willingness to test new ideas, learn and adapt in a changing environment.

Thank you for your interest in this vacancy, advertised by SMT Recruitment (Smart 10 Ltd), acting as an employment agency/business. Your application will be considered alongside others, and we will contact you within three working days if you are shortlisted.

SMT Recruitment is a multi-award-winning specialist recruitment consultancy providing temporary, contract, and permanent recruitment solutions across selected business sectors. title: Marketing Co-ordinator
description:
Marketing Coordinator - Hertfordshire

Hemel Hempstead

£32,000 - £35,000 + Bonus

Some marketing jobs are about keeping the wheels turning. This one gives you the chance to have a say in which direction they should be heading, too.

We're working on a retained basis with an established and growing business that is primarily B2 B with an element of consumer activity. They work with some seriously impressive technology brands and support high-profile customers with specialist equipment and solutions. They're now looking for a Marketing Coordinator who can keep campaigns moving, projects organised and deadlines under control, while also wanting to understand whether all that marketing activity is actually working.

The Role - Marketing Coordinator

You'll take ownership of the marketing plan, coordinating campaigns across different teams, stakeholders and external partners and making sure everyone has what they need to deliver. There will be plenty happening at once, so a big part of the role is keeping activity moving, deadlines on track and the various people involved pointing in roughly the same direction.

But this isn't just a case of ticking things off a marketing calendar. You'll be looking at the numbers too, monitoring KPIs, analysing campaign performance and ROI and working out what landed, what didn't and what could be done better next time. You'll also have the opportunity to contribute ideas and help shape future activity. If you spot an opportunity or think something could work better, they'll want to hear it.

Key Responsibilities - Marketing Coordinator
- Coordinating and delivering marketing campaigns and projects.
- Managing marketing plans, calendars, deadlines and activity schedules.
- Working with internal stakeholders and external partners to ensure campaigns are delivered effectively.
- Monitoring campaign performance, engagement and ROI.
- Collating and presenting marketing metrics and performance data.
- Identifying trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.
- Supporting the development of longer-term marketing strategy.
- Establishing and monitoring relevant marketing KPIs.
- Preparing reports and presentations for senior stakeholders and brand partners.

About You - Marketing Coordinator

You'll be organised, commercially aware and comfortable taking responsibility for getting things done. There will be multiple campaigns, deadlines and stakeholders competing for your attention, so you'll need to keep on top of the detail without losing sight of why you're doing it in the first place.

You'll also be comfortable with data. You don't need to be someone who dreams about spreadsheets, but you should want to know whether a campaign actually delivered rather than simply being pleased that it went live on time. Strong written communication skills, attention to detail and the confidence to put forward your own ideas will all be important. This is a role with a lot of responsibility, yet also the scope to grow with the business and own the marketing function.

Ideally, you'll have experience of:
- Coordinating and delivering marketing campaigns.
- Using marketing data and analytics to measure performance.
- Managing multiple projects, deadlines and stakeholders.
- Producing marketing reports and presenting results.
- Supporting wider marketing strategy and planning.
- Working independently and using your initiative to improve marketing activity.

The role is predominantly office-based, although there will be times when you'll visit customers, events and exhibitions, so a full UK driving licence is required. Based in Hemel Hempstead, the office is commutable from St Albans, Watford, Welwyn Garden City, Potters Bar, Luton, Hatfield, Ruislip and Beaconsfield.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager - Automotive Aftermarket

Letchworth, Hertfordshire

£43,000 - £48,000 + 10% Bonus + 7% Employer Pension + Private Healthcare + Excellent Benefits

Love cars, understand what makes automotive enthusiasts engage with a brand and want the freedom to shape a European marketing strategy rather than simply execute somebody else's?

This is an opportunity to take ownership of European marketing for a rapidly growing global automotive technology business operating at the heart of the performance, tuning, diagnostics and calibration market.

You'll have genuine autonomy to develop the strategy, create campaigns, shape content and decide how the brand engages with tuners, dealers and automotive enthusiasts across Europe.

And this isn't a marketing role where you'll spend your life briefing agencies from behind a desk.

You'll be close to the cars, customers and content, from dealer visits and product launches to race events, video shoots, influencers and social media.

If you're commercially minded, creative and genuinely passionate about cars, this could be a fantastic role to make your own.

Why Apply?
- £43,000 - £48,000 basic salary, with flexibility for exceptional experience
- Annual bonus potential of 10%
- 7% employer pension contribution
- AXA private healthcare after probation
- Life assurance at 4x salary after probation
- 22 days holiday plus 8 bank holidays
- Significant autonomy over European marketing strategy
- Work within the automotive performance and tuning industry
- Opportunity to influence the growth of a rapidly expanding global automotive technology business
- International exposure and travel
- Work alongside a passionate automotive team

The Opportunity

You'll report directly to the Director of European Operations and take responsibility for how the business markets itself across Europe.

Your objective is straightforward: increase brand awareness, engage the right automotive audiences and help drive sales growth.

You'll own the European marketing strategy and budget, but you'll also remain close to delivery.

That means developing campaigns, directing content, overseeing social media, managing paid advertising, supporting product launches, working with influencers, attending automotive events and making sure marketing activity translates into commercial results.

Content & Social Media

Content is a major part of this role.

You'll lead the social media strategy and manage the Social Media Coordinator, providing the ideas, direction and commercial thinking behind the content being produced.

You'll therefore need to understand the whole content creation process, not simply how to post on social media.

Digital Marketing

You'll also take responsibility for the wider digital journey.

That includes developing paid advertising campaigns across Meta platforms, defining audiences and messaging, monitoring performance and creating landing pages that convert interest into enquiries and sales.

You'll work with the wider international web team to develop the European website, monitor performance through Google Analytics and identify improvements in customer engagement and conversion.

Influencers, Events & the Automotive Community

This is where your genuine interest in cars becomes particularly important.

You'll identify relevant automotive influencers, negotiate partnerships and develop campaigns that put the brand in front of the right audiences.

You'll also plan and attend car shows, race events and other industry activities across Europe, overseeing everything from logistics and branding to networking and content capture.

Working With Sales

Marketing and sales won't operate in separate worlds.

You'll work closely with the European sales team, using customer feedback and commercial priorities to influence campaigns and content.

What We're Looking For

There are two things that are particularly important.

You need to understand the automotive aftermarket or tuning industry. And you need to genuinely love cars.

You'll be creating content for people who understand tuning, performance and vehicle technology, so you'll need the interest and credibility to understand what will resonate with them.

You'll also need:
- Strong experience developing and executing marketing strategy
- Excellent knowledge of social media and content creation
- Experience of storyboarding, scripting, filming and editing
- The ability to conceptualise and direct creative campaigns
- Paid social experience, particularly Meta
- Google Analytics experience
- Adobe Creative Suite knowledge
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Excellent organisational and project management skills
- Confidence managing multiple campaigns and priorities
- A creative, inquisitive and commercially minded approach

Additional European language skills would be advantageous.

Where Will You Work?

Ideally, you'll be based at the European office in Letchworth, Hertfordshire.

However, there is some flexibility for an exceptional UK candidate who cannot relocate, with hybrid working considered on the basis of a minimum three days per week in the Letchworth office.

Why Consider It?

This is a chance to combine a professional marketing career with a genuine automotive passion.

You won't simply inherit a calendar of campaigns and be asked to keep them running.

You'll have the autonomy to decide how the brand grows its European presence, which audiences it targets, what content it creates and how marketing can contribute directly to sales.

If cars are what you talk about outside work as well as something you understand professionally, this could be exactly the sort of marketing role you've been looking for.

Apply today, and Stewart Lupton at JSL Solutions, specialist in industrial and automotive aftermarket recruitment, will be in touch. Alternatively, call Stewart for further information.

JSL Solutions - Recruitment The Right Way.

Specialists in senior commercial and leadership recruitment for manufacturers and distributors across the automotive and industrial aftermarket.
